payload.title: Stability-regularized wide residual datum model
payload.statement: Existing cross-fitted wide legal datum actions may retain a small stable signed correction on top of E011, and only then may inner-fold feature/coefficient stability justify a new refit.
payload.evidence_for: Nested placement gains 0.057790 RMSE over E011, wins 5/5 maps and 21/25 cells, improves all three special slices, and defeats shuffled, permuted-family, and sign-flipped controls.
payload.evidence_against: The placed system regresses spatial group 3 by 0.091016 RMSE and typewell group 0 by 0.097205. P90 also rises by 0.031040. Exact reproduction confirms the failures.
payload.next_test: Closed by T016/D027. Do not refit or retune the same E009 action space. A future residual experiment requires a materially independent causal representation and a fresh preregistration.
